$comment: Links that vite's module graph cannot see, for scripts/affected-tests.mjs. `all`: a change to these paths runs the whole suite. `none`: paths no unit or contract test needs to run for (a test that reads one is still selected through its row). `links`: a changed path that matches `paths` selects `files` — a test file as it is, any other file (a module) through the tests that import it; a row with `"scan": true` adds its files but does not cover the path. Only rows written by hand live here: what each test file or helper reads by path is built from the test sources on every run (scripts/affected-tests-table.mjs), never committed, so a test file added, split or renamed by a parallel pull request cannot leave it stale. Patterns: `*` is any characters but `/`, `**` any number of folders. A path that nothing covers runs the whole suite.

all.why: dependencies and the Node version of every test
the configuration of the test run, how each file is compiled, the runner of `pnpm test`
setup files and what vitest.config.ts loads: they run around every test file
how git checks out and lists every file
the selection of the tests itself: a pull request that changes how tests are picked runs them all

none.why: documents, tickets and design mock-ups: no unit or contract test reads them

links.why: the shell tests of the Harness (harness/bin/tests, harness/hooks/tests), which harness-scripts.test.ts runs, start these scripts and read these texts
imported with ?raw, which the module graph does not follow
the zsh scripts: shell-integration.ts hands them to every Terminal's zsh
the quarantine entries, read by the helper the quarantined tests import
it follows the imports of the e2e and contract files into src/ and test/, looking for a process started on load
it reads the files of src/renderer/ as text
they list and copy the files of the folder
the e2e table of scripts/ci-scope.mjs, which reads it from the root it is given
